standard.summary: 将冻结的底模权重压缩为 FP8 或 INT8 格式，减少显存占用。可训练参数（LoRA）保持原始精度。
standard.effect: weight_compression_target 选择压缩范围（text_encoder/backbone/both）。weight_compression_format 选择格式（fp8_e4m3）。weight_compression_preset 提供预设（stable_backbone_int8 等）。
standard.whenToUse: 显存不足以容纳底模全精度权重时。FLUX/Anima 等大模型时特别有用。
standard.avoidWhen: 对底模精度极度敏感时。压缩可能导致细微的质量损失。

standard_en.summary: Compresses the frozen base model weights to FP8 or INT8 to cut VRAM use. The trainable parameters (the LoRA) keep their original precision.
standard_en.effect: weight_compression_target chooses the scope (text_encoder/backbone/both). weight_compression_format chooses the format (fp8_e4m3). weight_compression_preset offers presets (stable_backbone_int8 and others).
standard_en.whenToUse: When VRAM cannot hold the base model's full-precision weights. Particularly useful with large models such as FLUX and Anima.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When you are extremely sensitive to base model precision. Compression can cause a slight quality loss.

advanced.principle: FP8 E4M3 格式将 16-bit 权重压缩为 8-bit，显存占用减半。weight_compression_include_patterns/exclude_patterns 通过正则表达式精细控制哪些层被压缩。compression_companion 允许加载一个预训练的恢复适配器，在压缩前合并到底模中补偿精度损失。weight_compression_verify 在压缩后验证权重误差。
advanced.intervention: 模型加载后、训练前，对指定权重执行精度转换。推理时自动反量化。
advanced.expectedImpact: 底模显存占用减少约 50%（FP16→FP8）。训练速度不受影响（只有冻结权重被压缩）。
advanced.tradeoffs: weight_compression_allow_offload_combo 允许与 CPU offload 组合使用。

advanced_en.principle: FP8 E4M3 format compresses 16-bit weights to 8 bits, halving VRAM. weight_compression_include_patterns/exclude_patterns use regexes to control precisely which layers are compressed. compression_companion allows loading a pretrained recovery adapter merged into the base model before compression to compensate for precision loss. weight_compression_verify validates weight error after compression.
advanced_en.intervention: After model loading and before training, performs precision conversion on the specified weights; dequantizes automatically at inference.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Base model VRAM drops about 50% (FP16→FP8). Training speed is unaffected (only frozen weights are compressed).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: weight_compression_allow_offload_combo allows combining with CPU offload.
